_meta.game_version: 1.1.2.4 (decompiled) ; verified against 19 official 1.1 maps + 3 dev maps, 9 workshop maps, 2 saves, 1 user map
_meta.coordinates: Grid: x east, y north, z up. Entity BlockObject.Coordinates = placement origin (block (0,0,0) of the blueprint lands there), NOT the min corner of the rotated footprint. Saved Z = Coordinates.z + BaseZ (BaseZ=0 for every template here). Standing on ground whose top solid voxel is z-1 -> Coordinates.Z = z.
_meta.blueprint_block_order: BlockObjectSpec.Blocks index = (z*Size.y + y)*Size.x + x (z-major, then y, then x). Source: Timberborn.BlockSystem BlockObjectSpec.BlockSpecFromCoordinates.
_meta.transform: world = Coordinates + R(F(local)); F(x,y,z) = (Size.x-1-x, y, z) if Flipped AND blueprint Flippable else identity; R: Cw0 (x,y) ; Cw90 (y,-x) ; Cw180 (-x,-y) ; Cw270 (-y,x); z unchanged. Source: Timberborn.BlockSystem Blocks.Transform / BlockObjectSpec.GetBlocks, Timberborn.Coordinates OrientationExtensions.Transform, FlipMode.Transform. Same transform for entrance, cutout tiles, water-source tiles, water obstacles.
_meta.rotated_bbox_for_SxSy: Cw0: x[X..X+Sx-1] y[Y..Y+Sy-1] ; Cw90: x[X..X+Sy-1] y[Y-Sx+1..Y] ; Cw180: x[X-Sx+1..X] y[Y-Sy+1..Y] ; Cw270: x[X-Sy+1..X] y[Y..Y+Sx-1]. Coordinates from desired min corner (Mx,My): Cw0 (Mx,My) ; Cw90 (Mx, My+Sx-1) ; Cw180 (Mx+Sx-1, My+Sy-1) ; Cw270 (Mx+Sy-1, My).
_meta.entrance: EntranceBlockSpec.Coordinates (outside the footprint, e.g. (1,-1,0)) is transformed like a block; door faces Orientation.Transform(Down): Cw0 -y, Cw90 -x, Cw180 +y, Cw270 +x. Doorstep (inside footprint) = entrance - facing offset. Flip moves the entrance tile but not its facing.
_meta.orientation_serialization: Orientation omitted = Cw0; string 'Cw90' etc. (legacy {'Value':'Cw90'} also accepted). Flipped omitted = false; ignored for non-flippable templates. Enum.Parse is case-sensitive; unknown names throw during load.
_meta.matter_below: Ground: voxel(z-1) solid and voxel(z) air (z-1<0 counts as solid). GroundOrStackable: Ground OR a Stackable block of another object at z-1. Air: voxel z and z-1 both air and no Top-occupying object at z-1. Any: no requirement. Stackable: stackable object block below.
_meta.occupied_cells: Every block with Occupations != None must be inside map XY, z < 33 (TotalSize) and not inside terrain. Two objects may share a cell only if their Occupations flags are disjoint. OccupyAllBelow adds an All-occupation virtual block in every cell below down to z=0 (may be inside terrain) -> no other object anywhere underneath.
_meta.verification: Emulated load validation (BlockValidator + IBlockObjectValidators + BlockObjectBatchLoader order) with this transform: 0 failures among 58,388 BlockObjects in the 22 builtin maps and 0 among 43,223 in 8 workshop maps (plus 2 saves and 1 user map) (only the 90-layer Tower of Beaverlon fails, because the game truncates its terrain). Alternative 'min-corner' hypothesis: 82 builtin failures; reversed rotation direction: 76 failures.
_meta.templates_available_in_map_editor: Only the 'Common' template collection is loaded in the MapEditor context: all map objects listed here + Pine, Birch, Oak, Succulent, BlueberryBush. Maple/ChestnutTree/Dandelion are Folktails-only, Mangrove/CoffeeBush IronTeeth-only (TemplateCollection.NaturalResources.*); a map containing them fails to instantiate them ('Failed to instantiate' loading issue) for the other faction and in the editor.

StartingLocation.blocks_format: [x,y,z,'MatterBelow:Occupations[:stack][:OAB]'] for every blueprint block (G=Ground, GS=GroundOrStackable, A=Any)
StartingLocation.ground_requirements: foundation tiles [[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 2], [1, 0], [1, 1], [1, 2], [2, 0], [2, 1], [2, 2]] at local z=0 need GroundOrStackable below; all occupied cells (see tiles_cw0, incl. upper layers) must be air (not terrain) and within z<33
StartingLocation.transform_rule: world = Coordinates + R(F(local)); see _meta.transform (Flipped ignored: not flippable)
StartingLocation.notes: Overridable (any non-overridable object placed over it deletes it; only one may exist - setting one deletes the others). New game: faction StartingBuildingId (DistrictCenter.Folktails / DistrictCenter.IronTeeth, both 3x3x5, entrance (1,-1)) is created finished at the SAME Placement (Coordinates+Orientation), then all StartingLocations are deleted. Needs flat 3x3 ground at level z and 5 air layers z..z+4; entrance tile must be walkable ground at level z (else no beavers spawn). Verified: 21/21 builtin SL flat, entrance tile at ground level and free.

Slope.ground_requirements: foundation tiles [[0, 0]] at local z=0 need GroundOrStackable below; all occupied cells (see tiles_cw0, incl. upper layers) must be air (not terrain) and within z<33
Slope.transform_rule: world = Coordinates + R(F(local)); see _meta.transform (Flipped ignored: not flippable)
Slope.notes: Ramp from level z to z+1. High end (neighbour with top solid voxel = z, i.e. ground level z+1) is on local -y: Cw0 -> (x,y-1), Cw90 -> (x-1,y), Cw180 -> (x,y+1), Cw270 -> (x+1,y). Low end (neighbour ground level z, top voxel z-1) is the opposite side. Game validation does NOT check the high side; it is a pathing convention. Builtin: 183/183 high side = z+1; 178/183 low side = z (4 of 5 exceptions are chained slopes one level down).

Pine.ground_requirements: foundation tiles [[0, 0]] at local z=0 need Ground below; all occupied cells (see tiles_cw0, incl. upper layers) must be air (not terrain) and within z<33
Pine.transform_rule: world = Coordinates + R(F(local)); see _meta.transform (Flipped ignored: not flippable)
Pine.notes: Tree: Ground at z0 (any solid voxel below; no soil type exists); occupies All at z0 (and z1 for 3-high trees), crown layer F|B|C|P|M (no Top). No navmesh adder (does not restrict walking). Survival needs soil moisture (WateredNaturalResourceSpec DaysToDieDry) and no flooding (MaxWaterHeight 0) unless noted.
